faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for most products. Items must be in original condition with all accessories. Some products like USB chargers have a 60-day policy.

faqs.question: How long does shipping take?
faqs.answer: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping takes 2-3 business days. Free shipping on orders over $50.

faqs.question: Do you offer warranty on products?
faqs.answer: Yes, all products come with manufacturer warranty. Most items have 1-2 year warranty. Some premium items like SSDs have 3-year warranty. Details vary by product.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: You can track your order using the tracking number sent to your email after purchase. Visit our tracking page and enter your order ID to get real-time updates.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and cryptocurrency payments.

faqs.question: Is the Smart Watch waterproof?
faqs.answer: The Smart Watch Pro is water-resistant up to 50 meters (5 ATM rating). This means it's safe for swimming and snorkeling but not for diving.

faqs.question: Can I use the USB-C charger with my iPhone?
faqs.answer: Yes, our USB-C Fast Charger is compatible with all USB-C devices including recent iPhone models. However, the charger itself is USB-C, so you'll need a USB-C cable for iPhones.

faqs.question: How much storage is included in the Portable SSD?
faqs.answer: The Portable SSD comes in 1TB capacity. It can store approximately 250 4K movies or 500,000 photos depending on file sizes.

faqs.question: Do the headphones work with all devices?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Premium Wireless Headphones use standard Bluetooth 5.0, making them compatible with all smartphones, tablets, laptops, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices.

faqs.question: What is the battery life of the headphones?
faqs.answer: The Premium Wireless Headphones offer up to 30 hours of continuous playback on a single charge. They charge fully in approximately 2 hours via USB-C.
